evidence: Dense colored noise blankets the crate and background, masking surface texture and small markings while the bars and overall structure remain clear.
Heavy colored grain covers the buildings, sky, and hillside, substantially degrading fine textures despite clearly defined architectural edges.
General softness reduces facial and clothing detail, with a slight washed-out haze, while both children and their accessories remain readily inspectable.
Faces, hair, clothing, and small sign lettering are clearly resolved with clean edges and no meaningful visible degradation.
A large soft reddish obstruction covers the lower package and label, while grain and slight softness reduce clarity in the unobscured lettering.
Dense fine colored grain degrades faces, clothing, and tabletop surfaces, though the children and individual construction pieces remain identifiable.
A broad blown-out reflection erases package graphics and part of the main lettering, while softness reduces the fine detail of the coins.
Strong backlighting leaves the cat's face and much of its dark fur poorly resolved, although its outline and the surrounding desk remain clear.
Tree bark, surf, and shoreline remain well defined, with mild overall softness and reduced detail in the deepest foreground shadows.
Strong defocus leaves the magenta surface and pale decorative patterns broadly recognizable but eliminates nearly all fine texture and edge detail.
Pronounced softness and dim facial tones obscure the central people's features and fine altar details, although the ceremony remains interpretable.
Severe blur obscures the food illustration and small print, while a large clipped reflection wipes out the lower central packaging.
Leaf veins, droplets, and the insect's outline are clear, with slight softness limiting the finest detail on its body and legs.
Bright sky and ground highlights lose detail, while deep shadows obscure parts of the trees and trench, though the construction materials remain inspectable.
Heavy multicolored noise covers both faces, clothing, and signs, reducing fine detail substantially even though the lettering remains readable.
The figures' faces and molded clothing textures are cleanly preserved, with only slight softness on the right figure and lower edges.
Paint boundaries, brush textures, and the small signature are well preserved across the artwork without meaningful visible degradation.
Heavy blur affects the entire scene, erasing facial features, bib text, and foliage texture while preserving only broad runner silhouettes and colors.
A milky haze markedly reduces contrast in the hiker's face and upper body, while foreground grass and backpack details remain well resolved.
Visible grain and general softness reduce skin, hair, and hand detail, although the facial features remain clearly recognizable.
The goalie, equipment lettering, and net retain useful detail, with a mild gray haze and noticeable softness on the foreground player.
Truck grille mesh, license lettering, body edges, and surrounding building details are clearly resolved without meaningful visible artifacts.
Large bright areas on both flowers lose petal texture and tonal variation, while their outlines and the surrounding leaf veins remain sharp.
